SELECT rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TRUNC(rr.RECEIPT_DATE) ORDER BY rr.RECEIPT_DATE ASC) AS dailySequence , m.MEMBER_NAME , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS birthDate , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('2', '4', '6', '8') THEN '여' ELSE '남' END AS gender , m.MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER , TO_CHAR(rr.RECEIPT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS receiptDate , rr.RECEIPT_STATUS , rr.MEMBER_NUMBER , rr.SPACE_NUMBER , doc.MEMBER_NAME AS employeeName , dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME , CASE WHEN rr.RECEIPT_STATUS = '수납완료' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(p.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT p WHERE p.MEDICAL_NUMBER = rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER) ELSE ( (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(c.CONTRIBUTION,c.UNIT_PRICE)),0) FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS r JOIN COMMONCODE c ON c.COMMONCODE='P' AND c.CODENAME_1=r.TREATMENT_ITEM_NAME WHERE r.MEDICAL_NUMBER=rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER AND r.TREATMENT_STATUS='치료완료') + (SELECT NVL(MAX(NVL(c.CONTRIBUTION,c.UNIT_PRICE)),0) FROM COMMONCODE c WHERE c.COMMONCODE='A' AND c.COMMONCODE_NUMBER= (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>1 THEN 'A02' ELSE 'A01' END FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER rr2 WHERE rr2.MEMBER_NUMBER=rr.MEMBER_NUMBER)) + (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(NULLIF(m.CONTRIBUTION,0),m.UNIT_COST)*TO_NUMBER(NVL(i.DOSAGE,'1'))),0) FROM OUTPATIENTNURSE_INJECTION i JOIN MEDICINE m ON m.MEDICINE_CODE=i.MEDICINE_CODE WHERE i.MEDICAL_NUMBER=rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER AND i.INJECTED_YN='Y') + (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(m.CONTRIBUTION,m.UNIT_COST)*NVL(p2.TOTAL_QTY,1)),0) FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION p2 JOIN MEDICINE m ON m.MEDICINE_CODE=p2.MEDICINE_CODE WHERE p2.MEDICAL_NUMBER=rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER AND p2.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS='Y') ) END AS totalFee FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER rr INNER JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_NUMBER = rr.MEMBER_NUMBER LEFT JOIN MEMBER doc ON doc.MEMBER_NUMBER = rr.DOCTOR_NUMBER LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE emp ON emp.MEMBER_NUMBER = rr.DOCTOR_NUMBER LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT dept ON dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE = emp.DEPARTMENT_CODE
rr.RECEIPT_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND rr.RECEIPT_DATE < TO_DATE(NVL(#{toDate}, #{fromDate}), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
rr.RECEIPT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND rr.RECEIPT_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
AND rr.RECEIPT_STATUS IN ('진료중', '진료완료')
AND rr.RECEIPT_STATUS = #{status}
AND rr.DOCTOR_NUMBER = #{doctorNumber}
AND ( m.MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER LIKE #{keyword} || '%' OR SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) LIKE #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY rr.RECEIPT_DATE DESC

SELECT m.MEMBER_NUMBER , m.MEMBER_NAME , m.MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS birthDate , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('2','4','6','8') THEN '여' ELSE '남' END AS gender , m.PRIMARY_ADDRESS AS address FROM MEMBER m WHERE m.MEMBER_STATUS = '환자' AND ( m.MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR REPLACE(m.MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER, '-', '') LIKE '%' || REPLACE(#{keyword}, '-', '') || '%' OR m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER LIKE REPLACE(#{keyword}, '-', '') || '%' ) ORDER BY m.MEMBER_NAME FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_STATUS = '환자' AND RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER LIKE #{prefix} || '%'

SELECT rr.medical_number , rr.member_number , m.member_name AS memberName , m.member_phone_number , TRIM(m.primary_address || ' ' || m.detailed_address) AS address , m.postal_code , SUBSTR(m.resident_registration_number, 1, 6) AS birthDate , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.resident_registration_number, 7, 1) IN('2', '4', '6', '8') THEN '여' ELSE '남' END AS gender , TO_CHAR(rr.receipt_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS receiptDate , TO_CHAR(rr.treatment_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS treatmentDate , rr.receipt_status , rr.register_s AS symptoms , rr.register_p AS treatmentItem , rr.space_number , doc.member_name AS doctorName , dept.department_name AS departmentName , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM appointment a WHERE a.member_number = rr.member_number AND TO_CHAR(a.reservation_start_date, 'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR(rr.receipt_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AND a.reservation_status != '예약취소' AND a.attending_physician = rr.doctor_number ) THEN '예약' ELSE '당일' END AS visitType , (SELECT SUM(p.total_amount) FROM payment p WHERE p.medical_number = rr.medical_number) AS totalFee FROM receptionist_register rr INNER JOIN member m ON rr.member_number = m.member_number LEFT JOIN member doc ON rr.doctor_number = doc.member_number LEFT JOIN employee e ON rr.doctor_number = e.member_number LEFT JOIN department dept ON e.department_code = dept.department_code WHERE rr.medical_number = #{medicalNumber}

SELECT rr.medical_number , TO_CHAR(rr.receipt_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS receiptDate , doc.member_name AS doctorName , rr.receipt_status , rr.register_p AS treatmentItem FROM receptionist_register rr LEFT JOIN member doc ON doc.member_number = rr.doctor_number WHERE rr.member_number = #{memberNumber} ORDER BY rr.receipt_date DESC

SELECT rr.RECEIPT_STATUS AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER rr
rr.RECEIPT_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND rr.RECEIPT_DATE < TO_DATE(NVL(#{toDate}, #{fromDate}), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
rr.RECEIPT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND rr.RECEIPT_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
GROUP BY rr.RECEIPT_STATUS

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber} AND DOCTOR_NUMBER = #{doctorNumber} AND RECEIPT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND RECEIPT_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND RECEIPT_STATUS != '수납완료'
